classification.difficultyReason: Translate equalshaded/unshadedcircle areas to a direct radius-square equation and positive square root.

content.prompt: In the diagram, the outer circle has radius 10 cm and the area of the shaded region is equal to the area of the unshaded region. Find the radius of the small circle. Give the exact answer and also an approximation correct to 2 decimal places.

spec.description: Nonconcentric smaller circle inside outer radius10cm circle, source mathematical shaded difference retained using evenodd region (no white masks). Relative inner radius schematic; no calculated radius printed.
spec.answerVisibility: Only original given geometry/dimensions and shaded mathematical region; no calculated answers.

answer.worked:
The small circle has half the area of the outer circle, regardless of its centre position.
$$\begin{aligned}\pi r^2&=\frac12\pi(10)^2\\r^2&=50\\r&=5\sqrt2\text{ cm}\\r&\approx7.07\text{ cm}.\end{aligned}$$
